capabilities: run code fences with inline results in Reading view
edit examples and re-run, with copy and reset controls
execute seven languages in-browser without an account
route other languages to a local container companion or a named remote provider
prevent duplicate remote execution by retrying only when execution is known not to have started
extras: Remote execution is enabled by default; the README notes you should disable it in settings to prevent code being submitted to remote providers. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A user guide, roadmap, and release notes live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian renders code fences as static text, so readers cannot edit and run the code shown in a note and see the result inline.
summary: Turns run-* code fences into editable examples with inline output, executing via browser runtimes or optional local container and remote providers.
